import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
    static final int MAX_GRID = 14;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long f, c;

        Edge(int src, int dst, long f, long c) {
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            this.f = f;
            this.c = c;
        }
    }

    static class FlowGraph {
        int source, sink;
        List<Edge> edgeList;
        List<Integer>[] adj;
        int[] lvl;
        int[] ptr;

        FlowGraph() {
            edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
            adj = new List[MAX_SIZE];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            lvl = new int[MAX_SIZE];
            ptr = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        }

        void reset() {
            edgeList.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i) {
                adj[i].clear();
            }
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edgeList.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            edgeList.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edgeList.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edgeList.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean levelize() {
            Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(source);
            lvl[source] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int id : adj[u]) {
                    Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                    if (lvl[e.dst] == -1 && e.c > e.f) {
                        lvl[e.dst] = lvl[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lvl[sink] != -1;
        }

        long augment(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < adj[u].size(); ++i) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                int id = adj[u].get(i);
                Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                if (lvl[e.dst] == lvl[u] + 1 && e.c > e.f) {
                    long pushed = augment(e.dst, Math.min(flow, e.c - e.f));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.f += pushed;
                        edgeList.get(id ^ 1).f -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long compute() {
            long total = 0;
            while (levelize()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = augment(source, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static FlowGraph g = new FlowGraph();
    static char[][] map1 = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static char[][] map2 = new char[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int[][] timeDist = new int[MAX_GRID][MAX_GRID];
    static int N, T;
    static int[] sinkNode = new int[103];

    static int encode(int t, int x, int y) {
        return t * N * N + (x - 1) * N + y;
    }

    static void computeDist(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_GRID; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < MAX_GRID; ++j)
                timeDist[i][j] = 111;

        timeDist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1], d = cell[2];
            if (visited[x][y]) continue;
            visited[x][y] = true;
            timeDist[x][y] = d;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > N || ny < 1 || ny > N || visited[nx][ny] || map1[nx][ny] == 'Y')
                    continue;
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, d + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                map1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                map2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        g.reset();
        g.source = 0;
        g.sink = MAX_SIZE - 2;

        int startX = 0, startY = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (map1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= N * N; ++i)
            sinkNode[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (N * N - i);

        computeDist(startX, startY);

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(map1[i][j]))
                    g.connect(g.source, encode(0, i, j), map1[i][j] - '0');
                if (Character.isDigit(map2[i][j]))
                    g.connect(sinkNode[encode(0, i, j)], g.sink, map2[i][j] - '0');
                g.connect(encode(0, i, j), sinkNode[encode(0, i, j)], INF);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int step = 1; step <= T; ++step) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= N; ++j) {
                    if (map1[i][j] == 'Y' || map1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                        if (ni >= 1 && ni <= N && nj >= 1 && nj <= N &&
                            map1[ni][nj] != 'Y' && map1[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                            timeDist[i][j] >= step && timeDist[ni][nj] >= step) {
                            g.connect(encode(step - 1, ni, nj), encode(step, i, j), INF);
                        }
                    }
                    g.connect(encode(step, i, j), sinkNode[encode(0, i, j)], INF);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(g.compute());
    }
}
